notes: Wherefore goes to לָמָּה, which writes its own lexeme, and then to the waw as the connective left over, on rule 14's וְעַתָּה reading rather than by position.
do is the verb's own fronted auxiliary because the clause's interrogative לָמָּה already holds an English word of its own (rule 17's second limit); הֲ in the later clause does take its fronted did.
The margin's Or, made a mock of was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
